The car she wanted.
A deal worth a second look.

When Christina decided it was time for a new vehicle, she had her heart set on a beautiful 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLS 450. She had already visited her local dealership in California and received a quote, but she wanted to make sure she was getting the best deal possible.

That’s when she reached out to Done Deal Auto Group.

More savings.
A fresh start.

We helped Christina save thousands of dollars compared to her original dealership quote. We also helped her get out of her existing lease early with no additional charges.

Despite being on opposite sides of the country, we made the entire process simple, convenient, and stress-free.

Congratulations, Christina!

Helping people save money, avoid dealership headaches, and drive the cars they love is what Done Deal Auto Group is all about.

Thank you for trusting us all the way from California. Enjoy your beautiful new Mercedes-Benz!
